GUIDE.DEFAULT: Select a date range and click Generate to preview results. Use Excel, PDF, or email export to download the full file.
GUIDE.OVERVIEW: Purpose: Quick daily view of hotel financial health. How it works: Summarizes accrual revenue, cash movements, and key KPIs for the selected period so management can monitor performance at a glance.
GUIDE.ROOM_BOARD: Purpose: See room status at a specific moment. How it works: Uses the snapshot date to show each room as occupied, vacant, or reserved, grouped by building and floor—useful for front desk and housekeeping.
GUIDE.ARRIVALS_DEPARTURES: Purpose: Plan front-desk operations. For a single day: separate rows for arrivals, departures, and stayovers (matches the calendar day filter). For a date range: separate rows for each arrival, departure, or in-house stay within the period—the same reservations as the bookings list.
GUIDE.RESERVATIONS_LIST: Purpose: Review all stays in a period. How it works: Shows every non-cancelled reservation whose stay overlaps the selected dates (same logic as the reservations calendar filter).
GUIDE.OCCUPANCY: Purpose: Measure how fully the property is sold. How it works: Calculates room nights sold versus available rooms and shows occupancy rate for each day in the period.
GUIDE.ACCRUAL_REVENUE: Purpose: Report revenue earned by stay night (accounting accrual). How it works: Sums nightly charges from reservation_daily_charges by charge date—not by payment date—so revenue matches when the guest stayed.
GUIDE.CASH_BOX: Purpose: Track money actually received and refunded. How it works: Lists payments and refunds by transaction date (cash in / cash out) and shows net cash for the period.
GUIDE.REVENUE_SUMMARY: Purpose: High-level revenue trends over time. How it works: Rolls up accrual revenue into daily, monthly, or quarterly totals for charts and management review.
GUIDE.ACCRUAL_CASH_RECONCILIATION: Purpose: Explain differences between earned revenue and cash collected. How it works: Compares accrual revenue with net cash in the same period and highlights the gap (timing, unpaid balances, refunds).
GUIDE.AR_AGING: Purpose: Monitor unpaid guest balances. How it works: Groups outstanding amounts into 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and 90+ day buckets based on how long they have been due.
GUIDE.ADJUSTMENTS: Purpose: Analyze discounts, extras, and penalties. How it works: Breaks down non-room adjustments applied to reservations and their impact on subtotals and tax.
GUIDE.TAX: Purpose: Report VAT/tax collected on sales. How it works: Shows tax amounts by reservation and period based on confirmed stay charges and applicable rates.
GUIDE.REVPAR: Purpose: Benchmark pricing and occupancy performance. How it works: Calculates ADR (average daily rate) and RevPAR (revenue per available room) from accrual revenue and available room nights.
GUIDE.BY_DIMENSION: Purpose: Understand where revenue comes from. How it works: Splits revenue by booking source, stay reason, and other segments to compare channel and guest-type performance.
GUIDE.PEAK_ANALYSIS: Purpose: Evaluate peak-pricing strategy. How it works: Separates revenue earned on peak days/months versus standard rates and shows each share of total revenue.
GUIDE.PAYMENTS_REFUNDS: Purpose: Audit all cash movements on reservations. How it works: Lists every payment and refund with date, amount, type, and linked reservation for reconciliation.
GUIDE.CLOSING_PACKAGE: Purpose: Support day or month-end close. How it works: Bundles accrual summary, cash box, reconciliation, and AR snapshot in one export for finance sign-off.
GUIDE.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS: Purpose: Reference the general ledger structure. How it works: Lists all accounts with codes, names, types, and current balances as of the report date.
GUIDE.JOURNAL_ENTRIES: Purpose: Review accounting postings. How it works: Shows manual and system-generated journal entries with debits, credits, and references for the period.
GUIDE.GENERAL_LEDGER: Purpose: Trace activity by account type. How it works: Select an account type (required), optionally one account, then view debits and credits for that scope only.
GUIDE.TRIAL_BALANCE: Purpose: Verify books before closing. How it works: Lists every account with total debits, credits, and net balance to confirm debits equal credits.
GUIDE.PROFIT_LOSS: Purpose: Measure profit for a period. How it works: Builds an income statement from revenue and expense accounts for the selected date range.
GUIDE.BALANCE_SHEET: Purpose: Show financial position at a point in time. How it works: Reports assets, liabilities, and equity balances as of the end date.
GUIDE.CASH_FLOW: Purpose: Track how cash moved in the business. How it works: Classifies inflows and outflows into operating, investing, and financing activities for the period.
GUIDE.FINANCIAL_AUDIT_LOG: Purpose: Track what happened in accounting. How it works: Each row is one event (payment, room-night accrual, manual journal, or period close) with date, reference, and who performed it.

META.OVERVIEW_INTRO: Financial overview for the selected period.
META.EARNED_ACCRUAL_NOTE: Accrual revenue counts only stay nights through today (earned revenue). Future nights in the selected period are excluded.
META.EARNED_CASH_NOTE: Cash in/out includes only payments and refunds recorded through today within the selected period.
META.CASH_BOX_INTRO: Cash box report: payments and refunds in the selected period.
META.PAYMENTS_REFUNDS_CASH_SCOPE_NOTE: Filtered by record date; includes all real cash movements (confirmed, pending, and cancelled reservations) to match the ledger.
META.ACCRUAL_DETAIL_INTRO: One row per calendar day. Guest lists confirmed stays with earned revenue that night.
META.ACCRUAL_DAILY_GUEST_NOTE: One row per calendar day in the period. Guest lists confirmed stays with earned revenue that night.
META.ACCRUAL_DAILY_GUEST_OVERLAP_NOTE: One row per calendar day in the period. Guest lists every non-cancelled stay overlapping that day.
META.ACCRUAL_EARNED_CONFIRMED_NOTE: Accrual revenue counts only confirmed (or fully paid) stays through today (earned revenue). Future nights in the selected period are excluded.
META.ACCRUAL_REVENUE_CONTRIB_NOTE: Only confirmed reservations (status 1), or pending stays paid in full, contribute to revenue columns.
META.ACCRUAL_PENDING_PARTIAL_NOTE: Pending partial-payment stays appear in active bookings and guest names but not in revenue until confirmed or fully paid.
META.ACCRUAL_HIDE_EMPTY_ACTIVE: Filter active: days with zero room nights are hidden.
META.ACCRUAL_HIDE_EMPTY_ACTIVE_V2: Filter active: days with no active bookings and no room nights are hidden.
META.ACCRUAL_RECONCILIATION_NOTE: Confirmed reservations only (status 1). Revenue column includes tax. For an in-progress stay you see earned nights through today only—not the full reservation total. After checkout, sum rows for the stay dates to match the reservation total.
META.NO_RESERVATIONS_SEED: No reservations in the database. Run: php artisan db:seed --class=ReservationTestDataSeeder
META.RESERVATION_DATE_SPAN: Reservation stays in database: {{start}} → {{end}}. Match the report year to these dates (demo year is usually the current calendar year).
META.ARRIVALS_RANGE_NOTE: Date range: one row per arrival, departure, or in-house stay within the period (same reservations as the bookings list).
META.REVENUE_SUMMARY_DAILY_NOTE: One row per calendar day in the period. Active bookings matches the reservations list when filtering by that day. Room nights and revenue are from confirmed reservations only (status 1). In house shows occupied rooms on that day (any status).
META.REVENUE_SUMMARY_ACTIVE_NOTE: Active bookings: non-cancelled reservations overlapping that day (includes pending payment, status 2) — not only new bookings or confirmed nightly charges.
META.REVENUE_SUMMARY_BOOKED_NOTE: Room nights (booked): confirmed stays (status 1) with a nightly charge on that date — includes future dates in the selected period.
META.REVENUE_SUMMARY_EARNED_NOTE: Room nights (earned) and revenue: only nights through today (accrual). Future nights in an active stay show booked nights but revenue 0 until the night occurs.
META.RECON_ACCRUAL_RULE: Accrual: confirmed reservations only (status 1); revenue by stay night (charge date).
META.RECON_CASH_RULE: Cash: confirmed and pending payment (status 1 and 2); payments and refunds by payment date.
META.RECON_DIFFERENCE_EXPECTED: A difference is normal when stay dates and payment dates do not align (prepay, deposits, refunds).
META.RECON_PENDING_NOTE: Pending reservations (status 2) affect cash but not accrual until confirmed.
META.CLOSING_PACKAGE_NOTE: Closing package combines accrual, cash, AR, and tax for period-end review.
META.OCCUPANCY_AVAILABLE_NOTE: Available rooms = total sellable rooms minus booked room nights for that date. Occupancy % uses the same booked nights.
META.TAX_ALLOCATED_NOTE: Tax is allocated proportionally across daily charges at {{rate}}%.
META.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_NOTE: Chart of accounts with movement balances for the selected period.
META.CASH_FLOW_JOURNAL_NOTE: Cash flow from journal entries on cash/bank asset accounts.
META.FINANCIAL_AUDIT_LOG_NOTE: Includes payments, accruals, manual journals, and period closes for the selected dates.
META.FINANCIAL_AUDIT_LOG_ROW_NOTE: Each row is one accounting event: guest payment, room-night accrual, manual journal, or period close.
META.ROOM_BOARD_SNAPSHOT: Room board snapshot for {{date}} (uses end date as snapshot date).
META.AR_AGING_BALANCE_AS_OF_NOTE: Balance uses payments/refunds recorded on or before the as-of date.
META.AR_AGING_SCOPE_NOTE: Confirmed and pending-payment reservations (not cancelled) with balance_due > 0.
META.AR_AGING_BALANCE_FORMULA: Balance = reservation total − (payments − refunds) as of the selected date; total includes tax at {{rate}}%.
META.AR_AGING_DAYS_OVERDUE_NOTE: Days overdue are measured from check-out for past stays; current/future stays fall in the 0–30 day bucket.
META.ADJUSTMENTS_PERIOD_NOTE: Adjustments for reservations with daily charges in the selected period.
META.BY_DIMENSION_NOTE: Accrual revenue grouped by reservation source and stay reason.
META.BY_DIMENSION_RESERVATION_SCOPE_NOTE: Reservation count includes only stays with earned room-night charges through today in the period—not every booking that overlaps the period on the reservations list.
META.PEAK_CLASSIFICATION_NOTE: Peak classification comes from reservation_daily_charges.is_peak_day (peak period settings).
META.PEAK_ANALYSIS_PERIOD_NOTE: Peak day classification uses current peak-day settings applied to each charge date in the selected period (includes all booked nights in the range, not only nights through today).
